title: Therapeutic effect of Lepidium peruvianum Chacon mediated silver nanoparticles on fertility in adult male Sprague-Dawley rats
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,34016-34038
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05660H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ameer Hamza, Muhammad Babar Taj, Merfat M. Alsabban, Amal Marzoqi Altowerqi, Sarwat Jahan, Aysha Afzal, Saad Alghamdi
The study investigates male infertility by synthesizing silver nanoparticles (LP@AgNPs) using Lepidium peruvianum Chacon. LP@AgNPs showed significant improvements in reproductive tissues, spermatogenesis, and semen quality in Sprague Dawley rats.
